gloss: swimming goggles; underwater goggles; diving mask

definitions.gloss: swimming goggles; underwater goggles; diving mask
definitions.explanation: Covers both competitive swim goggles and snorkeling/diving masks.

examples.japanese: {水中|すいちゅう}めがねを{付|つ}けて{泳|およ}ぐ。
{子供用|こどもよう}の{水中|すいちゅう}めがねを{買|か}ってあげた。
examples.english: I bought children's swim goggles for them.

examples.japanese: {水中|すいちゅう}めがねをかけると、{海|うみ}の{中|なか}の{魚|さかな}がきれいに{見|み}えた。
examples.english: When I put on the goggles, I could clearly see the fish in the ocean.

notes:
A compound of {水中|すいちゅう} (underwater) and めがね (glasses/goggles). This is the general Japanese term for any eyewear used underwater, from children's pool goggles to snorkeling masks.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水中|すいちゅう}めがねを{付|つ}ける: to put on goggles
- {水中|すいちゅう}めがねを{外|はず}す: to take off goggles
- {水中|すいちゅう}めがねが{曇|くも}る: goggles fogging up

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ゴーグル: goggles (loanword, used especially for competitive swimming)
- {水中|すいちゅう}マスク: underwater mask (more for diving/snorkeling)
- {水中眼鏡|すいちゅうがんきょう}: same word using kanji for めがね (less common in everyday use)

USAGE:
In modern Japanese, ゴーグル is increasingly used for competitive swimming goggles, while {水中|すいちゅう}めがね remains the general term, especially in casual family contexts like pool or beach outings.
